content.text:
**@aaronjmars**  
**Full text:** exo is buzzing in AI twitter those days  

it's also very similar to aeon vision, that i've been building for the past 3 months, with the same thesis but a different implementation  

same idea:  
- stop building abstractions. put a durable agent in front of a frontier model and let it write its own extensions  
- long-lived, unattended, explicitly anti-approval-loop  
- authors its own new capabilities  
- forks itself into specialized copies, keeps a registry of them  
- identity in plain markdown you can hand-edit  
- an append-only log as ground truth  
- swappable underlying agent CLI  

different:  
- exo runs locally, forever. aeon runs on GitHub Actions  
- exo edits its harness live and rebuilds mid-session. aeon edits its harness through a PR that lands next run  
- both keep secrets out of context - aeon via a static command check + secretcurl, exo via a substrate that brokers them  
- exo hands you a substrate and you build the agent. aeon hands you skills and a dashboard  
- exo has no evaluation layer. aeon scores every run 1–5 with Haiku and auto-repairs after 3 failures   

exo is asking what an agent should be made of. aeon is asking what an agent should do today.
